settings.app.title: Settings
settings.archive.empty.desc: The archive button on a session row files that one session; the one on a workspace row files the whole group. Sessions left here are cleared automatically after 30 days.
settings.archive.empty.title: The archive is empty
settings.archive.noBridge: This window has no native bridge, so it cannot open folders (available in the desktop window): {message}

settings.archive.restoreGroupTip: Restore the {count} sessions in this workspace

settings.models.key.overwriteTip: Write a new value over it

settings.models.keyStatus.ready: {ref} is ready, from an environment variable or the credentials store

settings.models.removeProvider.defaultMo: This is the current default endpoint; after deletion the default moves to the first available endpoint.

settings.models.savedKeyFailed: The endpoint was saved, but the key was not written: {message}
settings.models.savedWithKey: {notice}; the API key was written to the credentials store

settings.models.validate.nameChars: The endpoint name may only use lowercase letters, digits, - or _.

settings.models.validate.noModels: At least one model is required (the model id is the name sent in requests).

settings.ui.collapseTiming.help: Fold a finished turn right away, or leave it open until your next message makes it a past turn.

settings.ui.configFailed: Could not switch the config file: {message}

settings.ui.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text manually
settings.ui.densityHelp: How loose the line height and vertical spacing feel overall.
settings.ui.emptySection: This section has nothing to configure.

Thinking rows in all four modes keep a first-line summary, which is independent of whether the whole turn folds.

settings.ui.fontFamily.text.label: Text font
